nom: StriVectin Hyperlift Eye Instant Eye Fix For Bags, Lines & Crepiness

segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes fumes and dryness so severe it visibly irritated her eyes after a single use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their senior years (including one 90-year-old and one 70-year-old) report visible tightening of under-eye bags and fine lines, though one notes her skin was not responding well.
segments.dry: A few reviewers report the product left their under-eye area noticeably dry or dried out, one describing it as the worst possible place to feel dryness.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visible softening of fine lines and wrinkles under the eyes, some saying results appear within minutes; a couple say results are underwhelming compared to advertising.
concerns.dehydration: Several describe the under-eye skin becoming dry, tight, or flaky after use, with one saying it dried her skin out to the point of causing a burning sensation.

aspects.libelle: Effect fades after a few hours
Small amount goes a long way

extraits.texte: Not only does this product not work, it dried out my eyes as fumes rose up my face. I used the tiniest amount but this still was the effect on my eyes. And, it did absolutely nothing to minimize my under-eye bags. I want to return it for a full refund. I am that disgusted with it. I only used it one time.

Although I did see a decrease in puffiness, this was extremely dry under my eyes, the one place you never want to look dry! And the pump bottle is hideous… I thought it was all gone after six uses! To then only find out these pump bottles stop working and they're still is a ton of product left in the bottle that now is in the trash… Had I known!!:( I do not recommend this product.

I've now been buying Hyperlift for almost a year. When used as directed, its a great product that eliminates my bags under my eyes. It does take some experimentation to get it right. Even just a little too much leaves you with a white powdery type residue around your eyes. But once you get the hang of it, it is very effective. My MAJOR problem with the product, and hence the two star rating, is it's packaging. The container used constantly gets clogged. If you don't use the product for a couple of days, the product in the dispenser tube just before it comes out drys out. This makes it impossible to get any of it out. If you press to hard it comes out of the sides. I emailed customer service and they told me to tap the container, which is plastic, on the bathroon sink to dislodge the dry pieces but that doesn't work. This is really a pretty good product in a POORLY DESIGNED container. They would have been just better off putting it in a tube, like a toothpast type container, that this fancy piece of garbage.

extraits.titre: Great Product: 3 Useful Notes for the Buyer
extraits.texte: This product is my go to for puffy eyes! I highly recommend it. I have purchased it at least 6 if not 7 times. However, I have 3 notes to keep in mind. First, despite what the directions say, you need to use this on a clean face, meaning do not use it if you have applied any serum, face cream, SPF, or foundation makeup to the eye area. It's been my experience that if you use it on top of another product of any kind it will create a visible white film. The worst part about that visible film is that it may take a while to appear. For instance, I applied the product on my puffy eyes at home, and about a half hour later I left for the day. Later in the day, I was mortified when I looked in a mirror and discovered two bright white half moons under my eyes! It looked like clown makeup, or like I had some type of skin condition. Second,the firmness (anti-puffing affect) begins to diminish after about 3 hours and seems to be gone after about 5 hours. My final note, is to be aware that when it seems as if there's no more product left (meaning when you press the pump and nothing comes out, even after shaking or tapping the bottle against a hard surface) what I've discovered is that the pump on the bottle cannot access all of the product. So, believe it or not, I've been taking a hammer to the container to remove the pump and access the remaining product at the bottom with a Q-tip. If you choose to try this, be sure to save the cap so you can keep the product moist. One of the beauties
I love this and have been using a few years. My only wish is for it to cost less!! But I will continue using. It decreases bags under my senior eyes.
Right eye works better than the left eye. African American facial skin at 70 years old not responding well. Working on timing for remaining motion less.

I am really happy with this product. I have tried the Peter Thomas Roth tightening cream for under eyes and it works but it almost always leaves a white residue. This Instant Eye Fix does not leave a residue and it makes me look so much more awake! Definitely would recommend!
